mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital for corporations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.3pp in a month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate below 0.25% and unemployment rate above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary policy response to labor market weakness, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days through increased liquidity and risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1.5 million units per month during late-cycle expansions indicates robust consumer demand, preceding positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through improved retail and construction sector performance.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST exceeds 1.5 million, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.5 percentage points in a month signals manufacturing sector strength, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days through improved corporate capital expenditure and earnings outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO rises by >0.5pp in a month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation acceleration exceeding 0.3 percentage points in a month signals persistent price pressures, triggering central bank tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises by >0.3pp in a month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll growth exceeding 100,000 jobs per month signals sustained labor market strength, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days through increased consumer spending and corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 jobs, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized signals robust economic expansion, preceding positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days through improved business investment and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
